structured_output.what_is_happening: MemeCard is a coin launched on a Meteora virtual curve that migrated immediately. It trades on a PumpSwap pair about 18 minutes old. It is up about 300% to a $218k market cap on $250k of volume. Buying is very lopsided: 1,626 unique buyers against 140 unique sellers, and momentum is still rising (+16–22% in the last 5 minutes). There are many same-name copycats; this is the leading one by market cap and liquidity.

narrative.description: 'MemeCard' seems to refer to a meme or X trading-card concept: the website is xmemecards.fun, and the linked X status is from CapyQuant_. It looks like a tweet or product-driven launch, typical of a Meteora launchpad.
narrative.why_spreading: The name spawned 7+ copycat tokens within minutes, which suggests an outside trigger (a tweet or product) is driving the attention. The buyer count is growing quickly.

token_connection.why_this_token: This token carries the project website and the X status link, and it has by far the most liquidity and buyers among the same-name tokens.
token_connection.competing_tokens: HwB2...pump (created earlier, $210k volume in the last hour but $5k market cap, so already dumped). GjE8...pump (created earlier, liquidity 0). Several other copies with liquidity near zero.

authenticity.evidence: Broad participation: 1,626 unique buyers and 391 in the last 5 minutes. But the 11:1 buyer-to-seller skew is extreme. GMGN tags 65 bundler wallets, and RugCheck finds an 89-wallet insider network. There is no paid DexScreener promotion, and fresh-wallet and bot rates are low. The project X account is recycled (renamed from PumpLiquidonSOL).
authenticity.uncertainty: No X data, so I can't confirm whether the linked tweet is a genuine catalyst. The 80% top holder is unlabeled; it may be a pool account.

From an entry 4 minutes late at about $220k, a drop of more than 50% is at least as likely as a doubling to about $440k.

structured_output.thesis: This is an above-average candidate. Buyer breadth is strong and accelerating, and there is no paid promotion. The coin is the clear leader among many same-name copies, which suggests an outside catalyst. Against that: the LP is flagged as unlocked, there is heavy bundler and insider presence, the X account is recycled, and the coin has already run 300%. I put the chance of a 2x higher than for a typical coin in the pool, but rug and fade risks are real.
